correctness.rationale: The arbitrary-order all-time harmonic ceiling follows from an exact finite multinomial expansion conditional on Poisson turns. One uniformly random turn gives the Beta(n+1,n+1) coefficient; events with at least two turns and one-turn Poisson correction give a rigorous the explicitly quantified second-order Poisson remainder remainder. All Gaussian noise effects cancel in the matched-law difference by exact radial Gaussian contraction. Root and rotated-root measures prove the maximal coefficient and the minimal moment order. The standalone stdlib checker passed 128 exact arithmetic and finite-rate assertions; it is not used to replace the analytical proof.

value.rationale: Fourier-dependent observability of biologically motivated turning angles is a published research direction, but knowing which moment may contain a mode does not quantify when and how strongly it becomes measurable. A universal order-\(t^{2n+1}\) response, a finite-time sign-guarantee uniform over all atomic/singular laws, thermal-diffusion immunity, and a sharp optimal-contrast turning pair provide mathematically motivated and useful benchmark information. Exact noiseless sensitivity is not misrepresented as statistical noise robustness.
